items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-4 in the iterate spec are implemented and marked [x] with evidence; no feature beyond FR-01.35's scope (top-level html_block passthrough) was added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: parseHTML's getAttrs wraps decodePayload in try/catch (malformed base64 -> {html:""} instead of throwing during ProseMirror doc parsing); detectHtmlLossiness wraps the markdown-it parse call in try/catch so malformed input degrades to 'not flagged' rather than crashing the modal.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL/DB surface touched. renderHTML returns a DOMOutputSpec with the raw HTML only as a string child (safe DOM text node, never innerHTML) -- verified by a dedicated <script>-payload test. The inline Link mark keeps the SAFE_LINK_PROTOCOLS allowlist. Block-level HTML is deliberately NOT scheme-sanitized (fidelity-over-sanitization, reviewed by both external LLM providers and documented in markdownRawHtmlBlock.ts + the iterate spec's Design Notes) -- the in-app DocumentMarkdown preview still sanitizes via rehype-sanitize on render, so this is an accepted, documented asymmetry rather than an oversight.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: markdownRawHtmlBlock.test.ts asserts on outcomes (toBe(source) byte-identical round-trips, DOM query for absence of a <script> element, window.__pwned undefined) not internal state. Happy-path (styled CTA, no-attribute, multi-line, between-prose) and edge/error-path (nested blockquote/list doesn't-throw, malformed decode fallback, javascript:-scheme block) are both covered.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Client-side editor extension only; no DB calls, no list endpoints, no loops over unbounded data. base64 encode/decode is O(content length) per block, same order as the content itself.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: markdownTiptap.ts (213 lines) was split into markdownEnvelope.ts (135) and markdownRawHtmlBlock.ts (189) to stay under the 300-line convention; markdownTiptap.test.ts (203) similarly split off markdownRawHtmlBlock.test.ts (169). File/folder locations and naming match the existing client/src/lib/ conventions.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer = markdown source file on disk (loaded via GET, edited in the TipTap editor); consumer = the same file written back via the SmartViewer save PUT. A real round-trip test exists at both layers: unit (roundTrip(source) === source across 8+ fixtures, plus tiptap-markdown's parse->RawHtmlBlock->serialize path) and E2E (markdown-editor.spec.ts's CTA-block test asserts the captured PUT body via mockCtaBlockFile contains the exact CTA_BLOCK string after an unrelated edit + save).

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff (via shipwright-plan project + shared/scripts/tools path) returned 'test_hygiene: no findings' against the working-tree changes.
